verdict.rationale: Qualcomm markets X2 Elite Extreme with peak-GHz and 'Performance Leap' claims, but community commentary explicitly notes 'not a single benchmark even against the previous generation' and urges waiting for independent reviews — directly contradicting any claim of demonstrated leading single-thread performance. No independent benchmark data exists since the chip hasn't shipped (2026 launch). Missing for 10: any independent single-thread benchmark (Cinebench, Geekbench single-core, etc.), hands-on reviewer corroboration, and even vendor-published comparative benchmark numbers.
